GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROC [d360].[SP_hash_log_LNS] AS
BEGIN

CREATE TABLE #tbl
WITH
( DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN
)
AS
SELECT  ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS Sequence
,       [TABLE_NAME]
,       'WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT COUNT(*) COUNT_TGT, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.'+TABLE_NAME+' WHERE H = ''D''
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM
)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,''F-'','''') COUNT_SRC, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.'+TABLE_NAME+' WHERE H <> ''D''
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)

INSERT INTO [d360].[HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,''_SRC'','''') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT *
FROM CTE12
) src

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC )
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT )
) pvt2' 
 AS sql_code

FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'D360' AND TABLE_NAME in (
'STG_LNS_ASSTCLASSDETAIL'
,'STG_LNS_COLTRLVEHDET'
,'STG_LNS_CUSTSBLIMITLINK'
,'STG_LNS_GENACCTCLASS'
,'STG_LNS_POSTDATEDCHQ'
,'STG_LNS_SECUDETAILRGTR'
,'STG_LNS_STANDALONECOLLMNT')
;

DECLARE @nbr_statements INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #tbl)
,       @i INT = 1
;

WHILE   @i <= @nbr_statements
BEGIN
    DECLARE @sql_code NVARCHAR(4000) = (SELECT sql_code FROM #tbl WHERE Sequence = @i);
    EXEC    sp_executesql @sql_code;
    SET     @i +=1;
END

DROP TABLE #tbl;
